title: Bitcoin Symbol: Copy & Paste ₿ — The Currency Sign Unicode Added in 2017
meta_description: Copy and paste the Bitcoin symbol (₿, U+20BF) and learn how it differs from the Thai baht ฿ and the BTC ticker. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: The currency sign for Bitcoin (₿), added to Unicode in 2017 after real demand — not to be confused with the Thai baht ฿ or the BTC ticker. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The Bitcoin symbol (₿, U+20BF) marks an amount denominated in Bitcoin — a price, a tip jar, a donation line. But unlike the older currency signs Unicode absorbed as routine formatting, ₿ was added in 2017 in direct response to organic demand from a fast-growing user base, and it's worn as an identity badge in bios about as often as it's used to write a number.
